notes.title: AV.0.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Andarilho - Alternative Version[/h1]

We are announcing a new version of the game Andarilho for testing! We're introducing a new low-poly style map and we want to hear your feedback. Come and try it out, and let us know what you think!


The development of the current version of Andarilho has been paused due to a lack of resources in the game's current style. We are considering a switch to a low-poly version and we need your feedback! Initially, we intended to use the low-poly style, but it was not well received at the time. Now, with its growing acceptance, we believe this change could enhance the game by introducing new cars, buildings, and more features. Additionally, there is the possibility of changing the game engine if players prefer this style. The low-poly version will be an alternative, and the current game will remain available.

We invite all players to try out the alternative low-poly version of Andarilho, which currently features only the low-poly map. We are eager to hear your thoughts on this new version and how it compares to the current game. Your participation is crucial in shaping the future of the game.

To access the new version, simply select the "Andarilho - Alternative Version" option in the Steam client. Try out this alternative low-poly version and share your feedback with us!

notes.title: V.2022.1.0
notes.notes:
New version available with a lot of improvements and fixes.



[h1]New maps[/h1]

The game now has 1 bigger map divided into 9 smaller maps, you will find a tunnel (more like a portal, like in Cube Land Arena ;) ) attached to the big walls. This new map system make it possible for me to update the game and add new regions in the future.



[h3]New rocks[/h3]

A new type of rocks was added to the game, you will find it usually next to the lakes.



[h3]Steam inventory[/h3]

Now you can see your Steam inventory in the game and you can delete items from your Steam inventory if you want, be aware that this action cannot be undone.



[h3]AI[/h3]

The AI is still not good, I didn't had the chance to work on it yet. Improvements will me made in the future but, for now you will find animals and enemies usually next to the lakes.



[h3]What's next[/h3]

I will let people play the game for a while to test it a  little more and as usual, if you run into any problems, please use our community hub to let me know.
Still have work to be done on stuff like AI and the building system, these improvements will be made and added to the game on the next updates.



[b]PS.: It doesn't make sense for me to keep the Supporters DLC anymore and it will be retired soon.[/b]

First I have to say something about the recent events involving the Lunar coins. Apparently there was a bug ON STEAM and some people were abusing it, as usual, indie devs were to blame. People were saying that we, devs, have bot accounts and there was a whole conspiracy theory about it.

It's sad to see how much prejudice we face, just because our game is cheap...



Now, one other thing that is bothering me is the art of the game. Andarilho started with a lowpoly art, later it was changed to a different art that I bought from a artist on the asset store. The thing is, that the artist has inpired his creation on another game, ?maybe too much?. Now I receive a lot of complaint because of that.

With that in mind I decided to go back to lowpoly. Having a simpler art in the game will make it easier to find it and the game will probably be developed faster.

I will stop everything I am doing now and I will start to replace a few things. For the next updates you will start see a few things being replaced and it will mix with the current art. The goal is to replace everything, little by little until everything is changed.

[list]

[*]Trading cards, you have to launch the game through Steam client to receive them, as usual, since they are a feature from Steam.
[*]Achievements, also works only if you start the game through Steam client.
[*]Updates, since the game is hosted on Steam server, without the client you will not be able to update the game anymore.

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello guys, I have a few things to share with you:


[olist]
[*] I'm working on this game alone, so I was using a pack with some things to speed up the development, but, after some problems with it I decided to replace it because I'm currently stuck on the development.
[*] The next update probably will delay a little because now a have  to redo a lot of stuff that was integrated with that third party package.
[*] So, it still a lot of work to replace stuff and make everything work again and that's why the next version will take some time to be released.
[*] Since I have to redo a lot stuff, this is the perfect time to give your feedback if you want something different in the game, but of course, I'll see if it fits on the project.
[*] I am preparing a new environment, one of the most frequent requests is for to be possible to interact more with the houses, so, I'll add that.
[*] Some of the features may disappear on the next version, but, it will be added in the future. Don't worry about it.
[*] Also, remember to give your feedback and if you find a bug or have any suggestion please let me know!
[/olist]

A primeira versão está aí, é ainda uma versão inicial do jogo e com poucas coisas para fazer. Por favor, reportem todos os bugs que encontrarem. 
Ideias e/ou sugestões são bem vindos.

Esta versão inicial conta com:

ːns_greenː Carros, todos os carros podem ser dirigidos.
ːns_greenː Fabricação de itens
ːns_greenː Mineração e coleta de recursos
ːns_greenː Caça, há alguns pontos onde é possível encontrar animais para caçar, será mais fácil de encontrá-los próximo aos lagos.
ːns_greenː Terreno de 16km²
ːns_greenː Um estrada que passa por todo o mapa
ːns_greenː Uma cidade


A ideia inicial para este jogo era ter apenas a cidades e o personagem tendo que sobreviver, no entanto, conforme eu fui jogando o jogo começa a ficar um pouco monótono após conseguir os recursos e construir uma base. Por isso estou avaliando a possibilidade de adicionar algum tipo de inimigo para dar mais dinâmica ao jogo.

Aqui estão algumas das coisas que ainda estão por vir:

ːns_blueː Novas armas para serem usadas
ːns_blueː Mais animais
ːns_blueː Mais carros
ːns_blueː Caminhões
ːns_blueː Mais cidades
ːns_blueː Algum tipo de inimigo, ainda não foi decidido qual
ːns_blueː E mais...
